title: eriogonum molestum var. davidsonii
intro: Eriogonum molestum var. davidsonii, commonly known as Davidson's buckwheat, is a shrubby perennial plant belonging to the Eriogonum genus in the Polygonaceae family. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Davidson's buckwheat include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
